#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an ICS calendar entry for the project kickoff meeting
next Monday at 10:00 AM local time, lasting 2 hours."""

import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone


def detect_iana_timezone():
    """Try to get the local IANA timezone name."""
    local_tz = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
    name = getattr(local_tz, "key", None)  # zoneinfo.ZoneInfo exposes .key
    if name:
        return name
    return "UTC"  # safe fallback


def next_monday():
    """Return the date of next Monday (strictly after today)."""
    today = datetime.now().date()
    days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Monday == 0
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7  # today is Monday -> use the following Monday
    return today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def fmt_ical_dt(dt):
    """Format a naive datetime as YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS for ICS."""
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")


def main():
    tz_name = detect_iana_timezone()
    monday = next_monday()

    dtstart = datetime(monday.year, monday.month, monday.day, 10, 0, 0)
    dtend = datetime(monday.year, monday.month, monday.day, 12, 0, 0)
    dtstamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@project-kickoff"

    ics = "\r\n".join(
        [
            "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
            "VERSION:2.0",
            "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN",
            "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
            "METHOD:PUBLISH",
            "BEGIN:VEVENT",
            f"UID:{uid}",
            f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
            f"DTSTART;TZID={tz_name}:{fmt_ical_dt(dtstart)}",
            f"DTEND;TZID={tz_name}:{fmt_ical_dt(dtend)}",
            "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting",
            "DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting to align on goals, scope, and next steps.",
            "LOCATION:TBD",
            "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
            "SEQUENCE:0",
            "BEGIN:VALARM",
            "ACTION:DISPLAY",
            "DESCRIPTION:Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes",
            "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
            "END:VALARM",
            "END:VEVENT",
            "END:VCALENDAR",
            "",
        ]
    )

    with open("project_kickoff.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(ics)

    print(f"Created: project_kickoff.ics")
    print(f"Timezone: {tz_name}")
    print(f"Date: {monday} ({monday.strftime('%A')})")
    print(f"Start: {dtstart.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}")
    print(f"End:   {dtend.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}")
    print(f"Duration: {(dtend - dtstart).total_seconds() / 3600:.0f} hours")
    print(f"UID: {uid}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
